description: Facts extracted from the Tax Foundation's 2026 state individual income tax table, used for personal_income_tax_base in axiom_oracles/data/jurisdictions.v1.json. no_individual_income_tax lists the states whose table row shows 'none' for rates and brackets. capital_gains_only lists the states the page says tax capital gains income only (the table marks Washington with a note that its rates apply to capital gains income of high-earning individuals). Every other state and DC taxes wage and salary income.

source.title: State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026
